excludedRights: Trademarks, trade dress, logos and other third-party rights are not granted.
Private originals, screenshots and full-library aggregate previews are not selected artwork; selected-only package previews contain selected assets only.
Bundled font files and notices retain their existing licenses; no MIT or CC override.

documentationArtwork.boundary: Only this new original documentation SVG; existing collection artwork, fonts, third-party assets, private originals and Git history are outside this new grant.

candidateReview.source: This independent local candidate contains the complete reproducible tool source needed to rebuild the selected 98-asset artwork set. Unselected artwork and private originals remain excluded.
candidateReview.gitHistory: This candidate's independent Git history was reviewed. The private original repository and its full history are separate, are not included, and are not cleared by this candidate review.

reviewLimitations: Review covers documented source/export trace, container metadata and visible content only; it is bounded and does not establish universal copyright or third-party-rights clearance.
